mechanics.claim: Q throws three cards in a cone that each deal magic damage to enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: throws a fan of three cards in a cone in the target direction that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Each enemy can only be damaged once per pass of the cards, not once per card.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be damaged only once per pass.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
